A '''Minister of Culture''' was a position within the structure of the [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] government. [[Kyu Tane]] held the position when the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|invaded]] Naboo in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].
